svg.title: TreeLab: group-bootstrap bagging with honest OOB support
svg.desc: Fixed validation prefix grid, OOB coverage and held-out metrics with preserved same-fit controls. Historical test reused, not a new blind benchmark.

g.text: 32 from-scratch trees. Exact copies travel together. Every draw, tree and prediction is saved.
1. Fixed validation grid, not OOB or test tuning
2,376 fit groups / 2,921 fit rows. G group draws per tree; expand copies with multiplicity.
Seed 20261108 / min leaf 5 / depth 20. Bootstrap row counts vary: 2,856 to 2,951.
* OOB MSE is row-weighted on each prefix's supported subset, not a fixed evaluation set.
Unsupported rows: 1,832 / 482 / 1 / 0. Zero votes mean null, never a fabricated zero prediction.
2. All controls use the same fitting rows
969 held-out rows. Historical test reused across versions: descriptive, not a new blind benchmark.
3. Row absence is not group absence
Witness: features [0, 0, 1, 1]; row draws [1, 1, 2, 2]. Row 0 is absent, its exact copy is in-bag.
Naive row-OOB squared error is 0. Group-OOB correctly excludes that prediction.
No feature subsampling: this is bagging, not a random forest. No calibrated uncertainty interval.
Exact-copy groups do not recover producer/batch identity. One seed and one split; no causal isolation.
UCI Wine Quality / Cortez et al. / CC BY 4.0. Established CART and bootstrap averaging, implemented here.
